about.description:
libigl is a simple python and C++ geometry processing library.
We have a wide functionality including construction of
sparse discrete differential geometry operators and
finite-elements matrices such as the cotangent Laplacian and
diagonalized mass matrix, and
simple facet and edge-based topology data structures.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.6.1"
  build_number: 4

package:
  name: igl
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/geometryprocessing/libigl-python-bindings/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1dc525138d39b361573fba5f909f294ac524c728016df9c6d9d0a19cc40f0f88
  patches:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: patches/0001-CMake-skip-stubgen-when-cross-compiling.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  script:
    env:
      # Keep peak memory within the Azure worker limit. Upstream defaults to
      # eight jobs; four also exhausted available memory in prior builds.
      MAX_JOBS: 2
    content:
      # On macOS, verifying a freshly extracted CMake binary can exceed
      # scikit-build-core's five-second discovery timeout. Prime it first.
      # https://github.com/scikit-build/scikit-build-core/issues/1530
      - if: osx
        then: cmake --version
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    # https://github.com/libigl/libigl-python-bindings/blob/main/cmake/Warnings.cmake#L2
    - cmake >=3.5,<4.0
    - make
  host:
    - libblas
    - libcblas
    - nanobind >=1.3.2
    - numpy >=2.0.0
    - packaging
    - pip
    - python
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - scipy
    - typing_extensions
  run:
    - numpy
    - python
    - scipy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - igl
      pip_check: false

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.TXT
  summary: Simple python geometry processing library
  description: |
    libigl is a simple python and C++ geometry processing library.
    We have a wide functionality including construction of
    sparse discrete differential geometry operators and
    finite-elements matrices such as the cotangent Laplacian and
    diagonalized mass matrix, and
    simple facet and edge-based topology data structures.
  homepage: https://libigl.github.io
  repository: https://github.com/libigl/libigl-python-bindings
  documentation: https://libigl.github.io/libigl-python-bindings/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - das-intensity
    - jeongseok-meta
    - teseoch
    - fwilliams
    - skoch9
    - danielepanozzo
